text: SELECT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase AS max_phase, md.molecule_type AS molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133765' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
